subject: science
title: Light and Sound Lab · Q3 W06 D01
objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Light helps us see. Sound comes from vibrations and can travel to our ears. Very bright light and very loud sound can harm us, so use safe levels. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: what you hear when something vibrates
to move back and forth quickly

items.prompt: Which helps us see in a dark room?
items.explanation: The best answer is: a lamp

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?

options.text: cover your ears at a very loud concert
put your ear right next to a loud speaker
scream close to your friend's ear
play very loud music all day

items.explanation: The best answer is: cover your ears at a very loud concert

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: do not point a laser at your eyes
shine a laser at your eyes

items.explanation: The best answer is: do not point a laser at your eyes

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a vibrating guitar string makes sound
a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: The best answer is: clapping hands makes sound

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: The best answer is: a lamp lights a dark room
